'''''Passiflora'' × ''violacea''''', the '''violet passion flower''', is a [[hybrid (biology)#In plants|hybrid]] between two [[species]] of [[flowering plant]]s, ''[[Passiflora racemosa]]'' × ''[[Passiflora caerulea]]'', in the [[family (botany)|family]] Passifloraceae. The name ''Passiflora'' × ''violacea'' has yet to be resolved as a correct scientific name;<ref name = TPL>{{cite web 
| url = http://www.theplantlist.org/tpl1.1/record/kew-2898928 | title = ''Passiflora'' × ''violacea''
| publisher= The Plant List | accessdate = 18 April 2018}}</ref> nevertheless it is widely found in the horticultural literature.

It is an [[evergreen]] [[vine|climber]] growing to {{convert|6 |m|ft|abbr=on}} with five-lobed leaves, clinging spiral tendrils, large showy purple flowers with maroon and white filaments, and the prominent [[Stigma (botany)|stigma]]s and [[anthers]] typical of the genus. While somewhat hardier than one of its parents, ''P. racemosa'', it is considerably less hardy than the other, ''P. caerulea'' (which can be grown outside in warm or coastal areas). ''P.'' × ''violacea'' will tolerate temperatures down to {{convert|-1 |C|F|abbr=on}}, but in most temperate zones is grown under glass, for instance in an unheated conservatory or greenhouse.

''Passiflora'' × ''violacea'' may well be the very first ''Passiflora'' to have been hybridised, by the British nurseryman Thomas Milne, in 1819. It was subsequently described by Joseph Sabine of the Royal Horticultural Society, then in 1824 by the French botanist Jean-Louis-Auguste Loiseleur-Deslongchamps in the "Herbier General de l'Amateur", giving it its current name.<ref>{{cite web 
| url = http://www.tropicalbritain.co.uk/climbers/passiflora-x-violacea-victoria.html
| title = ''Passiflora'' × ''violacea'' 'Victoria' | publisher = Tropical Britain | accessdate = 18 April 2018}}</ref>

This hybrid has in its turn given rise to several cultivars, notably 'Victoria'. It has won the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref name = RHSPF>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/60660/i-Passiflora-i-×-i-violacea-i/Details
| title = RHS Plantfinder - ''Passiflora'' × ''violacea'' | accessdate = 18 April 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web 
| url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/pdfs/agm-lists/agm-ornamentals.pdf | title = AGM Plants - Ornamental | date = July 2017 
| page = 72 | publisher = Royal Horticultural Society | accessdate = 17 April 2018}}</ref>
